card.name: Digits in years and toxicity grades
card.fires_on: The first digit of a year after a month name (2 in 2008, 2012), and the grade number after the word Grade in dose-modification tables. Also scattered linking words in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Year digit
modes.description: The leading 2 of a four-digit year right after a month name in dated prose.

modes.label: Grade number
modes.description: The number following Grade in adverse-reaction severity tables that say when to stop or hold a drug.
